output.title: AKS orders API with App Configuration
output.description: Bold lines carry requests and events. Dotted lines are dependencies: where the API gets its settings (two are Key Vault references), its identity, and where it reports.

simulations.title: Lunch rush
simulations.description: Steady orders: every request writes to SQL and publishes OrderCreated. Config, secrets and tokens were read at startup, so nothing moves on the dotted lines.

action.text: Orders flow through Front Door to the API, then to SQL and Service Bus.
No messages go to App Configuration or Key Vault: the API read them at startup and keeps them cached.

simulations.title: Flash sale
simulations.description: A spike to 300 orders a second for three seconds. Three replicas absorb it; the dependencies stay quiet.

traffic.label: 1,110 orders: steady, then a three-second sale

action.text: The sale starts: 300 orders a second for three seconds.
